protocol: identity-aware stratified Kaggle hold-out (1 of 5 folds), shared by both configurations; 5-fold identity-aware stratified CV on each training set; FFHQ human test never trained on
selection_rule: highest CV macro-F1 among RF, SVM, XGBoost and MLP; no test set was used for selection
macro_f1_on_ffhq_human_test: unweighted mean F1 over the shapes in the human labels (oblong, oval, round); predictions of other shapes count as errors
